description: Policy positions across officials by topic, covering who supports or opposes issues such as crypto, stablecoins, AI, healthcare, and guns. Each position carries a source URL and origin hash. Returns compact records by default (id, name, party, state, stance, summary, source) with a total count; the compact parameter controls row detail and offset controls paging.

compact.description: Compact mode (default). Small bounded record per position; use with offset to page. Set false for full rows (limit capped at 50).

limit.description: Max results per page. Compact: default 100, max 250. Full: default 25, max 50.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Response includes total; page by offset += limit.

topic.description: Policy topic label — use exact stored labels: Cryptocurrency, Technology, Healthcare, Immigration, Climate, Gun Control, Abortion, Taxes, Economy, Education, National Security, Housing, Criminal Justice, Social Security, Voting Rights, Agriculture, Trade

name: politics_positions
title: Policy Positions by Topic
